-- Pure reference for the result of swapping the ends of a list.
ends_swapped(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex ends_swapped([]) == []
  ex ends_swapped([7]) == [7]
  ex ends_swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  var ys = copy xs
  let n = ys.len()
  if n >= 2
    let a = ys[0]
    let b = ys[n - 1]
    ys[0] = b
    ys[n - 1] = a
  ys

swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  ex ends_swapped([1, 2]) == [2, 1]
  ex ends_swapped([1, 2, 3, 4]) == [4, 2, 3, 1]
  let n = xs.len()
  if n >= 2
    let a = xs[0]
    let b = xs[n - 1]
    xs[0] = b
    xs[n - 1] = a
